preference_rationale: Optimizing against Type I error is the right objective here, and A gets there through experimental design - clean matched controls and a placebo battery - rather than by leaning on niche statistical tests to rescue a contaminated regressor. For a mechanism question the causal story is the object, so a credible counterfactual beats a more sophisticated estimate of a magnitude.
why_loser_was_defensible: B is arguably the more statistically rigorous plan - it confronts the denominator circularity directly with a permutation null the estimate must clear, an instrument, and an independent event-study cross-check required to agree within 2x.
